title: Runtime Monitoring of Joint Multi-Robot Plans for Human Egress Safety (synthetic fixture)
abstract: SYNTHETIC TEST RECORD, not a real paper. We present a runtime monitor that checks a joint multi-robot plan before dispatch and rejects plans whose predicted robot positions would block a marked human exit. The monitor assumes bounded travel time between waypoints. In 200 simulated warehouse episodes the monitor rejected all 37 plans that blocked an exit, with a median check time of 12 ms. We discuss limitations under noisy localization.
